name: Twilight's Hammer
summary: The Twilight's Hammer is a nihilistic, apocalyptic cult dedicated to awakening the Old Gods and bringing about the end of Azeroth. Originally an orcish clan led by the ogre-mage Cho'gall, it has evolved into a secretive, multiracial order actively conducting dark rituals across Kalimdor and the Eastern Kingdoms.

sections.title: Origins in Shadow
sections.body: The Twilight's Hammer began on Draenor as an orc clan of the Old Horde, led by the two-headed ogre-mage Cho'gall, one of Gul'dan's chief lieutenants in the Shadow Council. Under Cho'gall the clan embraced a grim, apocalyptic creed, coming to see the Horde as merely an engine of destruction meant to bring about the end of all things.

sections.title: Arrival on Azeroth
sections.body: When the Twilight's Hammer crossed the Dark Portal during the First War, their apocalyptic fanaticism only deepened. In the soil of Azeroth, the cultists sensed the genuine whispers of the Old Gods—ancient horrors chained beneath the earth. Blackhand tolerated their erratic, ritualistic behavior solely because Cho'gall managed their bloodlust, deploying them alongside Kilrogg Deadeye's Bleeding Hollow clan in early assaults on Stormwind Keep. The clan later operated deep within Grim Batol during the Second War, overseeing critical refineries until Gul'dan's betrayal fractured the Horde. Though Orgrim Doomhammer ordered the traitorous clan butchered near the Tomb of Sargeras, a core cadre of zealots survived.

sections.title: A Spreading Cancer
sections.body: Upon reaching the forgotten shores of Kalimdor, the cult transformed from a shattered orc clan into a clandestine, multiracial conspiracy. Seducing disillusioned members of both the Alliance and the Horde, the Twilight's Hammer recruits any soul broken enough to welcome oblivion. In northern Kalimdor, led by Twilight Lord Kelris, cultists have entrenched themselves within the submerged halls of Blackfathom Deeps, feeding sacrifices to Aku'mai, a monstrous pet of the Old Gods. Further north in Darkshore, their excavators disturb the colossal fossilized remains at the Master's Glaive. Across the southern deserts of Silithus, camps of robed fanatics tend abyssal windstones, listening for the stirring of ancient horrors entombed beneath the sands.

faq.q: What is the Twilight's Hammer trying to achieve?
faq.answer: They seek the total annihilation of all life and order on Azeroth. Rather than seeking conquest or wealth, the cult views oblivion as a sacred blessing and actively works to release the ancient Old Gods chained beneath the world.

faq.q: Are they an orc clan or a cult?
faq.answer: They began as an orc clan on Draenor led by Cho'gall. After fleeing the Second War, they abandoned clan boundaries and transformed into a secret, multiracial cult, enlisting humans, night elves, dwarves, and anyone willing to worship the Void.

The cult was founded and overseen by Cho'gall, a cunning two-headed ogre-mage and former apprentice of Gul'dan. Local chapters operate under regional commanders, such as Twilight Lord Kelris in Blackfathom Deeps.

faq.q: Why are they in Blackfathom Deeps?
aliases: what are they doing in ashenvale
faq.answer: Led by Twilight Lord Kelris, the cultists occupied the sunken night elven temple along the Zoram Strand to worship and feed sacrificial victims to Aku'mai, a primordial three-headed hydra favored by the Old Gods.

faq.q: What are they doing at the Master's Glaive in Darkshore?
faq.answer: The Master's Glaive is a massive glaive embedded in the skull of a colossal creature; the Ancient of Lore Onu says an old, old lord of the earth fell there. Cultists congregate there to commune with its lingering dark energies and seek portents of their masters' awakening.

faq.q: Why did Orgrim Doomhammer try to wipe them out?
faq.answer: During the height of the Second War, Cho'gall and Gul'dan abandoned the Horde's march on Lordaeron to seek godhood at the Tomb of Sargeras. Furious at the treachery that cost the Horde its victory, Warchief Doomhammer dispatched loyal troops to slaughter the defecting clans.

angles.text: The Twilight's Hammer manipulates the same Void and shadow magic that shadow priests draw upon, serving as a dark warning of what happens when communion with the whispers overwhelms mortal sanity.

Though originally affiliated with Gul'dan's Shadow Council, the Twilight's Hammer abandoned demonic fel mastery in favor of the primordial madness of the Old Gods, making them unpredictable rivals rather than allies.

The cult is a shameful relic of the Old Horde's darkest days. Thrall's new Horde has rejected their madness entirely and actively executes any zealots attempting to seduce young orcs back into nihilism.
The defilement of holy sites like Blackfathom Deeps and the Master's Glaive by alien cultists represents a direct spiritual and physical assault on the sacred lands of northern Kalimdor.
